result:
All three findings (F-DG4-101, F-DG4-100 slice B, F-DG4-121) are repaired. Each failed its reproduction before the change and passes after, and every required check exits 0. Two things need your decision: a database migration number I had to propose myself, and a contract description that no longer matches the Finance dashboard. The changes are uncommitted. The handback is at `docs/delivery/handbacks/DG4/T-DG4-KBE-R5-kpi-benefits-engineer.md`, with logs in `T-DG4-KBE-R5-evidence/`. I ran from 00:58Z to 02:36Z.

**F-DG4-101 (mandatory): stale Finance corrections**
- Every amendment or reversal now bumps the original validation's version in the same transaction, under the 730233 lock, and writes a `finance_validation.corrected` audit event.
- The reviewer's F2 case: the second Finance user still holding the old ETag now gets 409 with the current version, nothing is written, and FIN-B's 900 stands. Before the fix it was accepted with 201.
- I added tests for stale amend then reverse, stale reverse then amend, and the database guard. I corrected the `corrections.test.ts` cases that reused one version.
- **Decision needed:** the existing database trigger made a decided validation completely unchangeable, so the version step was impossible without a schema change. I wrote `packages/db/migrations/0061_p4_finance_validation_correction_step.sql`. It adds one narrow exception: an approved validation that already has a correction may step its version by exactly 1, and nothing else may change. The work split says the orchestrator assigns repair-range numbers, so 0061 is marked PROPOSED. Please confirm or renumber it.

**F-DG4-100 (slice B): missing denial audit**
- Every refused slice B mutation now writes exactly one `authorization.denied` naming the permission. The four separation-of-duties refusals do the same.
- The new `slice-b-denials.test.ts` sweeps all 26 mutations as the auditor (AUD) and as the ADM-only user, and the six Finance decisions as a Business Owner. Before the fix, none of them wrote a row.
- The 403 response bodies are unchanged.

**F-DG4-121: gross and net**
- Benefit totals and the Finance dashboard now compute gross over margin uplift, cash saving and working capital only. Net is gross minus implementation cost.
- Revenue uplift and avoided cost remain their own lines. The per-class lines and validated totals are unchanged.
- The reviewer's DOM-GROSS case went from 435 to 90.
- **Decision needed:** the drill-down accepts only one value class, so it can't express a three-class gross. Where revenue or avoided-cost records exist, the gross line now has no drill-down link. Otherwise the link would open records that sum to more than the line. Elsewhere it keeps its link. The contract text for `FinanceValueLine.drilldownHref` says every gross line has a link, so it needs a description update or, later, a multi-class drill-down. ARCH-R4's task is descriptions-only and doesn't cover this.

**Byte stability:** I recorded 217 identical requests against the old and new code. 209 responses are byte-identical. The other 8 differ only in gross/net amounts, the gross drill-down links, and the corrected original's version/ETag. The overview, the gross-only transformation, every drill-down, and all 52 refusal bodies are unchanged.

**Checks (real exit codes)**

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `validate.mjs --historical --stage DG3` | exit 0 at start and end |
| `pnpm -r typecheck`, `pnpm lint`, prettier, `pnpm -r build` | exit 0 |
| `pnpm openapi:lint` | exit 0, 652 operations |
| `pnpm test`, locale unset and C.UTF-8 | 2772/2772, and 259 passed / 2 skipped, in both |
| `pnpm test:integration` | 1935/1935 tests, 203/203 files (13 new tests, 1 new file) |

**Failures along the way (all disclosed in the handback)**
- My first unit run had 3 failures, all mine: a lock number spelled out in a comment, and two code patterns the architecture scanner rejects. I fixed them and re-ran.
- My first full integration run failed 2 contract tests. The KBE-E contract exercise reused the old ETag, which the F-101 fix now correctly refuses. I had wrongly assumed it was unaffected. I fixed the exercise and the second full run passed.

**Other things to know**
- I edited one line in the QA-owned `tests/qa/integration/a10-benefit-integrity.test.ts`. Its REQ-S08-011 benefit was revenue uplift, which no longer counts in gross, so I made it margin uplift; its assertions are unchanged. qa-verifier may want to re-author it.
- The DG3 business-case totals still sum all financial classes into one gross. They are outside D-117's scope, so I left them unchanged and noted it for the round-2 domain reviewer.
- No pending operations moved; all my lists were already empty.
